question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"falter" **means to start to lose strength or momentum.
 
• **It fits the context of the sentence, which indicates a disruption in the flow of speech.**
 
• The other options: "malfunction," "default," and "prompt" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *His speech had begun to falter__, and he passed abruptly from one subject to another.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Malfunction:** means to fail to function normally.
 
• **Default:** means failure to fulfill an obligation.
 
• **Prompt:** means to encourage to speak or act.
